external_entities.name: member
external_entities.description: A library member who uses the library app to borrow, renew or reserve books.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Members borrow, renew and reserve books through the library app on their phones.

external_entities.name: desk staff
external_entities.description: Library desk staff who use the circulation page to modify member loan and account records.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Desk staff can extend a loan, clear a block on a member's account or mark a book as returned by hand
external_entities.notes: The staff use one shared login, so activity cannot be attributed to an individual or branch.

processes.name: library app
processes.description: The app on a member's phone used to request borrowing, renewals and reservations.
processes.source_excerpt: The app on their phone calls the lending API.

processes.name: lending API
processes.description: The REST service that applies loan rules and reads or writes the loans database.
processes.source_excerpt: It's a REST API. JSON in, JSON out.
processes.notes: The Lending service note says, "The lending API is internal-only." The Interview transcript says, "The phones talk straight to the lending API over the internet." These are conflicting exposure claims, so exposure is unknown. Authentication is also unclear: Priya said, "I think it checks a token the app gets at sign-in" and could not say what it accepts or does with a rejected call. The service has no queue in front of it and has gone down under peak load.

processes.name: self-service kiosk
processes.description: A branch kiosk at which members scan their library card and books when borrowing or returning them.
processes.source_excerpt: The kiosks are in every branch and they send each loan and each return to the lending API as it is scanned.
processes.notes: The text does not establish whether kiosks communicate directly with the loans database.

processes.name: circulation page
processes.description: The page used by desk staff to extend loans, clear account blocks and mark books as returned.
processes.source_excerpt: someone at the desk opens the circulation page and marks it returned, or clears the block on the account.
processes.notes: The lending service note says the lending API serves this page.

data_stores.name: loans database
data_stores.description: The database containing members, contact details, borrowing history, loans and reservations.
data_stores.source_excerpt: Names, email addresses, home addresses and every member's full borrowing history live in the loans database.
data_stores.notes: The former separate reservations database was merged into this database; the old reservations database is gone.

data_flows.name: borrow renew reserve
data_flows.description: A member uses the library app to request a borrowing, renewal or reservation.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Members borrow, renew and reserve books through the library app on their phones.
data_flows.data_description: Member and book or title details for a borrowing, renewal or reservation request.

data_flows.name: change loan
data_flows.description: The library app sends borrowing, renewal and reservation requests to the lending API.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The app on their phone calls the lending API. It says which book and which member, and the API checks the loan rules and writes the change.
data_flows.notes: Priya was uncertain whether the API checks a sign-in token and what it accepts from an invalid caller.
data_flows.data_description: The member and book or title involved in a borrowing, renewal or reservation.

data_flows.name: send loan return
data_flows.description: A kiosk sends a loan or return to the lending API as it is scanned.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The kiosks are in every branch and they send each loan and each return to the lending API as it is scanned.
data_flows.data_description: A member's scanned library card and book information for a loan or return.

data_flows.name: manage account
data_flows.description: Desk staff use the circulation page to extend loans, clear blocks and mark books returned.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Desk staff can extend a loan, clear a block on a member's account or mark a book as returned by hand, through a circulation page the lending API serves.
data_flows.notes: Everyone uses the same shared login; the page does not ask again and its history records only that the loan was closed by hand.
data_flows.data_description: Loan and member-account changes made by desk staff.

data_flows.name: update loan account
data_flows.description: The circulation page sends desk staff's loan and account changes to the lending API.
data_flows.source_excerpt: through a circulation page the lending API serves.
data_flows.data_description: Loan extensions, returned-book markings and cleared member-account blocks.

data_flows.name: read write records
data_flows.description: The lending API reads and writes member, loan and reservation records in the loans database.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The API is the only thing that reads or writes it.
data_flows.data_description: Members, email addresses, home addresses, borrowing history, loans and reservations.

trust_boundaries.name: branch network
trust_boundaries.description: The network used by branch kiosks and desk staff.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: The kiosks sit on the branch network.

trust_boundaries.name: council data centre
trust_boundaries.description: The council data-centre zone where the lending API and loans database run.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: The lending API and the loans database run in the council data centre.

trust_boundaries.name: member phone
trust_boundaries.description: The member-controlled phone zone where the library app runs.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: The app on their phone calls the lending API.

trust_boundaries.name: internet
trust_boundaries.description: The internet through which phones reach the lending API.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: The phones talk straight to the lending API over the internet.
trust_boundaries.notes: This is a named network through which the API is reached, not a placement for the API.

assumptions.assumption: The loans database contains confidential data because it stores members' names, email addresses, home addresses and full borrowing histories.
assumptions.basis: The Interview transcript states: "Names, email addresses, home addresses and every member's full borrowing history live in the loans database."

assumptions.assumption: The member phone is a separate tenant-controlled zone because the library app runs on the member's phone rather than in the council environment.
assumptions.basis: The sources describe "the app on their phone" and members' phones communicating with the council lending API.
